therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Bortezomib + Arsenic Trioxide + Ascorbic Acid + Melphalan
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: proteasome inhibition combined with arsenic trioxide cytotoxicity and high-dose alkylating agent
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: myeloma cell death through multiple cytotoxic pathways

results.dose_information: Bortezomib: 1.0 or 1.5 mg/m² IV on days -9, -6, -3; Arsenic trioxide: 0.25 mg/kg IV daily x7 days; Melphalan: 100 mg/m² IV on days -4, -3; Vitamin C: 1000 mg IV daily x7 days
